units.source_text: 庆祝升官的大飨宴办过之后，朝中别无紧要公事。

en.t: After the grand banquet celebrating the promotion was over, there were no urgent affairs at court.

units.source_text: 岑寂无聊之时，降下一天秋雨。

en.t: At that quiet, tedious time, autumn rain fell all day.

units.source_text: 有一个“荻上冷风吹”的秋夕，内大臣前来参见太君，

en.t: On an autumn evening when a cold wind blew over the reeds, the Inner Minister came to pay his respects to the old lady,

units.source_text: 又把女儿云居雁叫来，命她弹琴。

en.t: and he also summoned his daughter Kumoinokari and ordered her to play the koto.

units.source_text: 太君精通一切乐器，都已传授给孙女云居雁。

en.t: The old lady was skilled in every kind of instrument and had taught them all to her granddaughter Kumoinokari.

units.source_text: 内大臣说：“琵琶这乐器，女子弹奏时似乎不很雅观，然而声音还是悦耳动听的。

en.t: The Inner Minister said, "The biwa is an instrument that may not look very graceful when a woman plays it, yet its sound is still pleasing and beautiful.

units.source_text: 现今世间，受到正确师传的人恐怕没有。

en.t: In the world today, there is probably no one who has received proper instruction from a true master.

units.source_text: 算来只有某亲王，某源氏……”

en.t: If one counts them, there are only such people as a certain prince and a certain Genji..."

units.source_text: 数了几个人之后，又说：“女子之中，源氏太政大臣养在大堰山乡的明石姬，据说手段十分高明。

en.t: After naming several people, he continued, "Among women, Lady Akashi, whom the Genji Grand Minister keeps at his mountain villa in Oi, is said to be extremely accomplished.

units.source_text: 这个人祖上都是音乐名家，传到她父亲一代，长年隐居在明石浦山乡，不知怎的她也弹得如此高明。

en.t: Her ancestors were all renowned musicians, and although by her father's generation the family had long lived in seclusion in the hills of Akashi Bay, somehow she too plays with such remarkable skill.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣常常称赞这女子琵琶弹得特别好听。

en.t: The Genji Grand Minister often praises this woman's biwa playing as especially beautiful.

units.source_text: 音乐的才能，与别的技艺不同，必须与广众合奏，多方磨练，方能进步。

en.t: Musical ability differs from other arts: one must play in ensembles with many others and polish one's skill in many ways before improving.

units.source_text: 这女子独自弹奏，也会进步，倒是很难得的。”

en.t: For this woman to improve even by playing alone is truly rare."

units.source_text: 说罢，劝请太君演奏。

en.t: Having said this, he urged the old lady to perform.

units.source_text: 太君说：“我拂柱的手，已经很生硬了呢。”

en.t: The old lady said, "My hand for brushing the bridges has grown quite stiff now."

units.source_text: 试弹一曲，音节甚美。

en.t: She tried playing one piece, and the notes were very beautiful.

units.source_text: 弹毕说道：“那明石姬真好福气！

en.t: When she had finished playing, she said, "That Lady Akashi is truly fortunate!

units.source_text: 听说人品也非常好。

en.t: I hear that her character is also excellent.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣一向没有女儿，她倒替他生了一个。

en.t: The Genji Grand Minister had never had a daughter, and she was the one who bore him one.

units.source_text: 大臣又恐这女儿住在山乡不得发迹，把她带到自己身边，交与那位高贵的紫夫人抚养。

en.t: The minister then feared that the girl would have no prospects if she lived in the mountain village, so he brought her to his own side and entrusted her upbringing to the noble Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 人都称赞他想得周到呢。”

en.t: Everyone praises him for having thought it through so carefully."
